Enclosing class:
PatternLayout
public static interface PatternLayout.LogPatternEntry
Defines an interface for formatting log entries in a customizable and extensible manner. Implementations of this interface allow specific components of a log entry to be processed and appended to a Appendable in a format defined by the implementing class.

  • Method Details

    • format

      void format(Appendable app, long timestamp, String loggerName, LogLevel lvl, @Nullable String mrk, @Nullable MDC mdc, @Nullable Location location, @Nullable String msg, @Nullable Throwable t, ConsoleCode consoleCodes) throws IOException
      Formats a log entry by appending its components to the given Appendable instance. This method is responsible for processing and serializing the provided log data into a custom format defined by the implementing class of the interface.
      Parameters:
      app - the Appendable instance to which the formatted log entry will be appended
      timestamp - the timestamp of the log event (milliseconds since epoch)
      loggerName - the name of the logger that generated the log event
      lvl - the LogLevel representing the severity level of the log event
      mrk - an optional marker for the log entry, or null if not provided
      mdc - an optional MDC containing diagnostic context data, or null if not provided
      location - an optional Location detailing the source of the log event, or null if unknown
      msg - a Supplier providing the log message, or null if not available
      t - an optional Throwable associated with the log event, or null if no exception occurred
      consoleCodes - a ConsoleCode defining console-specific format codes
      Throws:
      IOException - if an I/O error occurs while appending to the Appendable instance
